integrity: All proof steps and reproducible finite checks are documented in RESULT.md and VERIFICATION.md; each claim of finite checking refers to the embedded programs and output. No independent validation or historical priority guarantee is asserted.
scientific_limitations: The conclusion applies to synchronous three-state Greenberg–Hastings dynamics on a labelled clique with s pendant leaves at one hub for r>=2, s>=1; it does not treat other graph grafts or update rules. Prior general finite-graph circulation criteria already characterize possible fixation versus oscillation, and only the temporal counts and individual basin-layer law are asserted as the new result. Historical originality is qualified by discoverable literature access and no independent scientific audit.
title: Universal leaf-entry profiles and ten temporal basin classes for three-state excitation on pineapple graphs
